---
title: Mixed references
author: Mickaël Canouil
date: 2026-11-13
format:
  mcanouil-html: default
  mcanouil-revealjs: default
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: gold
    type: workshop
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: A citation that mixes a workshop solution with another reference warns once, names the citation, and is left to Quarto, which resolves the other reference.
        warnings: exhaustive
    mcanouil-html:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        - level: WARN
          regex: 'mcanouil: the citation \[@sol-a; @sec-intro\] mixes workshop solutions with other references, so it is left to Quarto, which cannot resolve the solutions; cite the solutions in a citation of their own\.'
          count: 1
        - level: WARN
          regex: 'Unable to resolve crossref @sol-a'
          count: 1
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<a href="#sec-intro" class="quarto-xref">Section(&nbsp;| )1</a>']
    mcanouil-revealjs:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        - level: WARN
          regex: 'mcanouil: the citation \[@sol-a; @sec-intro\] mixes workshop solutions with other references, so it is left to Quarto, which cannot resolve the solutions; cite the solutions in a citation of their own\.'
          count: 1
        - level: WARN
          regex: 'Unable to resolve crossref @sol-a'
          count: 1
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<a href="#/sec-intro" class="quarto-xref">Section(&nbsp;| )1</a>']
---
